subtitle: A Jellyfin player for films and shows.
localizedDescription:
Kinema is a native iPhone and iPad client for Jellyfin, made to look and feel like Kultr.

• A home page with featured titles, Continue Watching, Next Up and what's new in every library.
• Big, artwork-tinted pages for every film and show: cast, seasons and episodes, similar titles, versions, and badges for 4K, HDR, Dolby Vision and Atmos.
• A player made for watching: swipe for brightness and volume, double-tap to skip, hold for 2× speed, pinch to fill, chapters, Skip Intro and Skip Credits, Up Next, speed from 0.25× to 4×.
• Subtitles drawn by Kinema: size, colour, outline, background, position and brightness, a second subtitle track at the same time, a delay to fix out-of-sync files, and online subtitle search.
• Plays everything your server has: MP4 and MOV directly, MKV and the rest repackaged or converted by the server on the fly.
• Picture in Picture, AirPlay, background audio, and trickplay thumbnails while scrubbing.
• Downloads for watching offline, with your progress sent to the server later.
• Several servers and users, Quick Connect, and liquid glass on iOS 26.

Free and open source: github.com/evropiani/Kinema
